subject: integration
name: Qwant
summary: A pointer to Qwant, a Web2 search service. Text typed in the address bar opens https://www.qwant.com/?q=<text> in the tab, so Qwant's own servers and code answer and see the text and the connection's IP address; nothing checks the results. With search suggestions on (off by default, never in a private window) the text typed so far also goes to api.qwant.com, with no cookie or referrer. Level 1, not 2: what it shows is Qwant's pages, not content Orivon pins. Judged here by its publisher.
